The '''Deluxe Undersea Package''' was a package holiday advertised and sold by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency<ref name="Star Tours" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]]<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> to the luxurious [[Sea Castle Resort Hotel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Praya]], a submarine [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] that was rated five stars by the [[Milky Way Guide]]. It had an accomplished staff and deep sea food was a specially. Activities included exploring the serene [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] in a [[Marine-speeder|marine speeder]] from [[Sea Base 2000]] and encountering rare [[Water/Legends|water]] creatures, as well as hunting for treasure in [[Unidentified sunken ship (Praya)|sunken ships]].<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deluxe Undersea Package was first mentioned in [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]].<ref name="Star Tours" />
